messages:
Maya (People Ops): Heads up everyone 1 were launching the PTO Donation Pilot + Compassionate Leave guidelines next week. Purpose: let teammates donate unused PTO to colleagues facing major personal crises. Details + form: https://redwood.inc/policies/pto-donation-pilot. Please skim and share feedback. :handshake:

Diego: Nice! who can donate and how much?

Maya (People Ops): Anyone FT/PT with >=40 hours accrued. Donate in 4-hr increments, max 40 hours/year. Donated hours convert at donor pay rate and go to approved recipients. Recipients must have exhausted their PTO.

Hannah: What documentation is needed to qualify?

Maya (People Ops): Minimal verification: hospital note, shelter intake, police report, etc. Well keep records confidential. People Ops + a small approval panel review within 5 business days.

Ravi (Payroll): FYI: donated hours are taxable in recipients payroll. Well report per regular payroll rules. If urgent cash is needed before payroll, request an `URGENT-ADV` and Finance will escalate.

Nia (Legal): Legal note: donations are irrevocable once processed. No employment law change  this is discretionary company paid time.

Maya (People Ops): Pilot runs 6 months. Well measure donors, hours moved, approval time, and any abuse patterns. Confidential feedback form in the doc. Office hours on Friday 10:00 AM PT.

Diego: Thanks  will share with my team.

Hannah: Appreciate the confidentiality bit. :heart:

HR-Bot: Policy published by Maya (People Ops)  https://redwood.inc/policies/pto-donation-pilot (version 1.0, effective next Monday).

Maya (People Ops): Thanks all. If youre a manager, join the 15-min manager Q&A Friday after hours to review approvals flow. DM People Ops for edge cases.
